title: Python Decorators
summary: A decorator is a function that wraps another function to add behavior without changing its code. It is applied with the @decorator syntax.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to return the wrapper function
Calling the function instead of passing it to the decorator
Forgetting to return the result of the decorated function
practice_idea: Create a decorator that prints a message before and after a function call.

title: Python List Comprehensions
summary: A list comprehension builds a new list from another iterable in a single, readable line, optionally filtering the elements.
key_concepts: Expression and loop in one line
common_mistakes: Writing comprehensions that are too long to read
Putting the if condition in the wrong place
Using a comprehension only for its side effects
practice_idea: From a list of numbers, build a list containing the squares of the even numbers only.

title: Python Virtual Environments
summary: A virtual environment is a folder with its own Python and libraries, so each project keeps its dependencies separate.
common_mistakes: Installing packages without activating the venv
Committing the venv folder to Git
practice_idea: Create a venv, install one library, save it in requirements.txt, then recreate the environment from that file.

title: C Pointers
summary: A pointer is a variable that stores the memory address of another variable. It lets functions modify data and work with arrays and dynamic memory.
common_mistakes: Dereferencing a NULL or uninitialized pointer
Confusing the pointer with the value it points to
Returning the address of a local variable
practice_idea: Write a swap function that exchanges the values of two integers using pointers.

title: Recursion
summary: A recursive function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the same problem until it reaches a base case.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the base case, which causes infinite recursion
Not making the problem smaller at each call
Using recursion where a simple loop is clearer
practice_idea: Write a recursive function that returns the factorial of a number.
